hooks.command:
echo '{"additionalContext": "## Project Context
Branch: '$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo 'N/A')'
Rust toolchain: '$(rustc --version 2>/dev/null || echo 'not found')'
Last commit: '$(git log --oneline -1 2>/dev/null || echo 'no commits')'
Dirty files: '$(git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null | head -5 | tr "
" ", " || echo 'none')'
TODOs: '$(grep -rn "TODO\|FIXME\|HACK\|XXX" src/ 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d " ")' found"}'

INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'cargo publish|rm -rf target/|git push.*--force|git reset --hard'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked: destructive or publish command. Confirm intent explicitly."}}'; fi; exit 0

INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '(Cargo\.lock|rust-toolchain\.toml|\.github/workflows/)'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Protected file: '"$FILE"'. Confirm?"}}'; fi; exit 0

INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE 'Cargo\.toml$'; then cd "$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.cwd // "."')" && cargo check 2>&1 | tail -5 >&2; fi; exit 0

MSG=$(cat | jq -r '.message // "Claude Code needs attention"'); if command -v osascript >/dev/null 2>&1; then osascript -e "display notification \"$MSG\" with title \"Claude Code\""; elif command -v notify-send >/dev/null 2>&1; then notify-send 'Claude Code' "$MSG"; fi; exit 0
